content: MeshTransmissionMaterial (drei) causes ONE additional render pass of the scene per material. Key perf props: samples (default 6, lower = faster), resolution (set to 32-64 for mobile, not fullscreen), roughness (add blur passes at low-res). transmissionSampler=true uses THREE.js internal buffer (cheaper, can't see other transparent objects). Mobile degradation path: use transmissionSampler=true + samples=2-3 + resolution=32 on PerformanceMonitor decline, or fall back to MeshPhysicalMaterial with opacity+roughness (no transmission pass). The host mesh is removed from the render stack temporarily. One mesh = one material = 1-2 draw calls baseline.
